QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Dr. Betty's Measures
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Dr. Betty in Ellinia.
QuestInfo.1: You received the Directional Sonar from Dr. Betty. Will this really help in finding the children? Take the equipment back to Headmistress Ivana. #b#e(Forfeit then restart the quest if you lose the item.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You received #b#t4033830##k from #b#p1032104##k in Ellinia. When you used it you could hear the voices of the children from the academy!

npc.0: I hope this helps you with your little fairy problem. I can't keep those cell samples waiting any longer or they'll start a revolt...\r\n(Return to the Ellinel Fairy Academy).
